answer_1.quote: We investigate language confusion on the line and word level in two practical settings: a) Monolingual generation, where a user queries the LLM in a given language, implicitly requesting an answer in the same language; and b) cross-lingual generation, where a user explicitly instructs a model to generate text in a different language.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated text for language consistency, focusing on line-level and word-level language confusion in multilingual LLMs.

answer_2.quote: We calculate binary metrics to indicate whether a response contains any instance of a) a line in an incorrect language and b) an isolated English word for languages using ¬ Latin scripts and an out-of-Unicode-range character for Latin script languages.
